_README: Single source of truth for the whole site. Everything visible on aty.ch
comes from this file plus the photos in photos/.
null means NOT YET FILLED IN. The build renders those as a loud amber
placeholder locally so you can see what is missing, and REFUSES to build
in --strict mode (which is what CI runs). That is deliberate: the flyer
PDF went out with $[PRICE] and [PHONE] still in it, and a published site
with a literal placeholder on it is worse than no site.
Fill in every null, then `nix develop -c ./build.sh` to preview.

site.title: 2011 Mitsubishi Pajero 4WD — for sale in Australia
site.description: 2011 Mitsubishi Pajero, 4WD, with a 23ZERO rooftop tent and rear drawer system. Proven on beaches, dunes and the long roads up north. Ready for your trip.

hero.headline: Toffee knows the way.
hero.lede:
Red dunes, empty beaches, mountain lookouts, the Territory.
This Pajero has been there and back. It’s ready to go again, this time with you behind the wheel.

included: Full camping kitchen setup (cookware, utensils, the lot)
Cast iron cookware for campfire cooking
4x4 off-road air compressor 4x4 – brand new, never used
_hint: Three short paragraphs, in your own words. The flyer template suggested:
1. My favourite night was camped at Watarrka National Park, cooking on the fire while the sun went down over the NT.
2. My road trip is coming to an end and it's time for him to move on. I'd love him to go to someone who'll really use him.

3. Yes, he's done 368,000 km – but you won't find a single engine problem or major repair in his history, just regular services. Fresh oil and all new filters in August 2026. Come and see him for yourself and take him for a drive.
